channel.title: Hoang-Vu Le — Notes
channel.description: Notes on AI, ML, RL and software engineering.

item.title: CONGA, explained: sequential recommendation over very long histories
item.description: A plain-language walk through CONGA (RecSys '26): rotary positions, KromHC multi-stream fusion and a TITANS memory for long histories, what the numbers show, and where it does not help.

item.title: Speculative decoding: the acceptance rate is 1 − TV, so train for TV, not KL
item.description: Speculative decoding is lossless, and its acceptance rate is exactly 1 − TV(p, q). Why that makes KL the wrong objective for training the draft model.

item.title: Thinking longer, voting more: the maths of why test-time compute saturates
item.description: Best-of-n costs log n − (n−1)/n nats of KL, voting saturates near 1/ρ effective samples, and thinking longer can lower accuracy. Three ceilings.

item.title: Why doubly-stochastic mixing keeps residual streams balanced
item.description: Row sums of one are not enough. Why the mixing matrix between parallel residual streams should be doubly stochastic, shown with a short proof sketch and a toy experiment.

item.title: Chinchilla in one derivation
item.description: One short calculation turns a three-term loss and a compute budget into the Chinchilla allocation rule. Here is the derivation, a picture, and the caveats.

item.title: How to read an LLM benchmark without fooling yourself
item.description: A statistics primer for leaderboards: standard errors, the unbiased pass@k estimator, Elo as SGD on Bradley–Terry, position bias in LLM judges, and Goodhart.

item.title: Idempotency keys: making retries safe
item.description: Networks time out, clients retry, and side effects repeat. How an Idempotency-Key makes retries safe, with a tested FastAPI example and notes on Redis and Postgres.
